definitionZh: : local-link CSS伪类代表同一文档的链接. 因此,一个元素是超链接的源锚,其目标绝对URL与元素自己的文档URL匹配.
sourceDefinition: The :local-link CSS pseudo-class represents a link to the same document. Therefore an element that is the source anchor of a hyperlink whose target's absolute URL matches the element's own document URL.
